items.exampleEn: A small blaze started in the kitchen, but the cook put it out quickly.
items.exampleZh: 廚房起了一場小火，不過廚師很快就把它撲滅了。

items.exampleEn: Immerse the vegetables in cold water for one minute.
items.exampleZh: 把蔬菜浸在冷水裡一分鐘。

items.exampleEn: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.
items.exampleZh: 那隻鳥拍拍翅膀飛走了。

items.exampleEn: Please don't tread on the newly planted grass.
items.exampleZh: 請不要踩剛種好的草地。

items.exampleEn: Each runner in the relay ran four hundred meters.
items.exampleZh: 接力賽中每位跑者都跑了四百公尺。

items.exampleEn: This machine uses compression to turn trash into small blocks.
items.exampleZh: 這台機器用壓縮的方式把垃圾變成小方塊。

items.exampleEn: She radiates confidence whenever she speaks.
items.exampleZh: 她每次說話都散發出自信。

items.exampleEn: Sharing the work lightened everyone's load.
items.exampleZh: 分攤工作減輕了每個人的負擔。

items.sentenceEn: Her funny story lightened the mood in the room.
items.sentenceZh: 她的趣事讓房間裡的氣氛輕鬆了起來。

items.audioEn: Our class came second in the relay because one runner fell near the finish.
items.audioZh: 我們班在接力賽得了第二名，因為有一位跑者在接近終點時跌倒了。
items.questionZh: 他們班為什麼得了第二名？
options: A runner was too slow near the end
Someone fell close to the end
They ran the wrong way at the start

items.sentenceEn: The flag flapped loudly in the strong wind.
items.sentenceZh: 旗子在強風中啪啪作響。

items.sentenceEn: We could hear him tread slowly up the old stairs.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聽得到他慢慢踩著舊樓梯上樓。

items.stemEn: The warm stove ____ heat all over the small room.
items.stemZh: 溫暖的爐子把熱氣散發到整個小房間。

items.stemEn: The ____ of the video file made it small enough to send by email.
items.stemZh: 影片檔經過壓縮後，小到可以用電子郵件寄出。

items.passageEn: During our winter trip to the mountains, we stayed in a wooden cabin with a big fireplace. Every evening, the blaze in the fireplace kept the whole room warm. I immersed myself in a long novel, while my brother played cards with our parents. Outside, snow fell quietly all night. By the end of the week, I felt that the quiet days had lightened the stress of my busy year.
items.passageZh: 冬天到山上旅行時，我們住在一間有大壁爐的小木屋。每天晚上，壁爐裡的熊熊火焰讓整個房間都很溫暖。我沉浸在一本長篇小說裡，弟弟則和爸媽玩牌。屋外整夜靜靜地下著雪。一週結束時，我覺得那些安靜的日子減輕了我忙碌一年的壓力。

questions.questionZh: 這趟旅行對作者有什麼影響？

items.promptZh: 接力賽是運動會的最後一個項目。
referenceEn: The relay is the last event of the sports day.
The relay race is the final event on sports day.
rubricZh: 要用 relay（例如 the relay、the relay race）
「運動會」可寫，例如 sports day、the school sports meeting 等
「最後一個項目」可寫，例如 the last event、the final event 等

items.promptZh: 雨停以後，天空漸漸變亮了。
referenceEn: After the rain stopped, the sky slowly began to lighten.
The sky gradually lightened after the rain stopped.
rubricZh: lighten 當不及物動詞「變亮」（例如 the sky lightened、began to lighten 等）
「漸漸」可寫，例如 slowly、gradually 等，位置不扣分
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 lightened、lightens 等）
